BEGINNING OF CONVERSATION: USER: I am trying to put my lawn mower up for the winter, what do I need to do? ASSISTANT:

Before putting your lawn mower away for the winter, make sure it is empty of fuel and all the oil has been completely drained. Clean the carburetor, spark plugs, and air filter. Store the lawn mower in a cool, dry place, preferably indoffic. Make sure the mower is not placed in an area where it could accumulate any dampness or moisture.
